summary: Presents a framework for consent-based communications in SIP. SIP lets requests such as invitations and instant messages reach a recipient with no consent, which can be misused for abuse, including amplification and denial of service attacks. The framework lets a recipient grant permission before a relay sends them such requests. It was updated later.

eli5.summary: You would not want strangers to ring your bell nonstop. This sets up a way for a person to say yes, it's okay, before a message service will pass things along to them.
